mapper.update: update _volunteer_guide set voLocation = #{voLocation}, voTarget = #{voTarget}, voContent = #{voContent}, voCapacity = #{voCapacity}, voManager = #{voManager}, voContact = #{voContact} where guideId = 1

update _volunteer set voTitle = #{voTitle}, voLocation = #{voLocation}, voTarget = #{voTarget}, voContent = #{voContent}, voCapacity = #{voCapacity}, voManager = #{voManager}, voContact = #{voContact}, voStartDate = #{voStartDate}, voEndDate = #{voEndDate}, voRecruitStart = #{voRecruitStart}, voRecruitEnd = #{voRecruitEnd}, status = #{status} where voId = #{voId}
mapper.select: select v.*, (select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = v.voId and status != 'CANCELED') as applicationCount from _volunteer v where v.voId = #{voId}

select v.*, (select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = v.voId and status != 'CANCELED') as applicationCount from _volunteer v where v.status = 'active' and v.recruitStatus = 'OPEN' order by v.voRegDate desc
limit #{start}, #{size}

select v.*, (select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = v.voId and status != 'CANCELED') as applicationCount from _volunteer v where v.status = 'active' and v.recruitStatus = 'CLOSE' order by v.voRegDate desc
limit #{start}, #{size}
select a.*, v.voTitle, v.voStartDate, v.voEndDate, v.voManager, v.voContact, v.voLocation, v.voContent from _volunteer_apply a join _volunteer v ON a.volunteerId = v.voId where a.voId = #{voId}
select count(*) from _volunteer_apply where volunteerId = #{volunteerId} and status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
